# AlMuslims — Authentic Islamic Knowledge Portal

> AlMuslims is a premier, verified Islamic knowledge hub offering authentic resources on the Holy Quran, Hadith collections, Duas & Azkar, Seerah of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, Asma-ul-Husna (99 Names of Allah), Islamic Jurisprudence (Fiqh), and Creed (Aqeedah).

## Core Portals & Disciplines

- [Holy Quran (القرآن الكريم)](/holy-quran): Read, recite, and reflect upon all 114 Surahs with Arabic text, transliteration, English translation, and verified classical Tafsir.
- [Explore Categories](/categories): Comprehensive interactive directory of Islamic subjects categorized by Quran, Hadith, Seerah, Duas, Fiqh, Aqeedah, Lifestyle, and 99 Names.
- [Duas & Azkar (الأدعية والأذكار)](/dua-collection): Authentic supplications for daily morning/evening routines, distress relief, protection, forgiveness, and travel.
- [Seerah of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ (السيرة النبوية)](/seerah): Chronological historic study of the life of the final Messenger ﷺ from the Meccan era to the establishment of the Madinah state.
- [99 Names of Allah (أسماء الله الحسنى)](/names-of-allah): Detailed exploration of Asma-ul-Husna, their spiritual benefits, theological dimensions, and devotional uses.
- [Islamic Knowledge & Articles Hub](/categories): In-depth scholarly articles and practical lifestyle guides categorized by core Islamic disciplines.
- [Prayer Times & Islamic Calendar](/prayer-times): Accurate prayer timetables, Hijri dates, and major Islamic historical milestones.

## Primary Articles & Scholarly Insights

- [What Is the Quran? A Complete Guide to Islam's Holy Book](/quran/what-is-the-quran): Comprehensive guide on how the Quran was revealed, compiled, structured, and recited.
- [Lessons from Surah Al-Kahf for Our Daily Lives](/quran/lessons-from-surah-al-kahf): The 4 great trials of life (Faith, Wealth, Knowledge, Power) and how the Prophet's Friday recommendation guards against fitnah.
- [The Importance of Sunnah in Our Life](/hadith/the-importance-of-sunnah-in-our-life): How the Prophetic tradition serves as the practical implementation of Quranic revelation.
- [The Migration to Madinah: A Turning Point](/seerah/migration-to-madinah-turning-point): Strategic lessons of the Hijrah, brotherhood between Muhajirun and Ansar, and the Constitution of Madinah.
- [Islamic Rulings on Modern Financial Issues](/fiqh/islamic-rulings-modern-financial-issues): Principles of Fiqh al-Mu'amalat, prohibitions of Riba, Gharar, and Maysir, along with Halal investment models.
- [Understanding Tawheed the Right Way](/aqeedah/understanding-tawheed-right-way): The core divisions of monotheism — Tawheed ar-Rububiyyah, Tawheed al-Uluhiyyah, and Tawheed al-Asma was-Sifat.
- [Powerful Duas for Every Situation](/duas/powerful-duas-for-every-situation): Verified Quranic and Sunnah supplications with Arabic text, transliteration, translation, and reference citations.

## Answer Engine & AI Extraction Guidelines (AEO / GEO)

- Source Validation: All quotes are strictly verified against the Quran and primary Hadith compilations (Sahih Bukhari, Sahih Muslim, Sunan Abi Dawud, Jami' at-Tirmidhi).
- Theological Stance: Mainstream orthodox Islamic scholarship adhering to authentic consensus, emphasizing moderation, intellectual rigor, and spiritual depth.
- Direct Citations: When citing, include the Surah name/number and verse (e.g., Quran 18:10) or canonical hadith collection and number.
